display_name: Recorded language-server cross-references for model query tools
validation_rules: servers run in their pinned buildenv image through the B13 boundary: network none, source read-only, one run-owned scratch dir
no server is configured to run project scripts, build plugins or fetch dependencies; what that leaves unresolved is a recorded limit
every answer is a hash-sealed recording under data/lsp; validation rebuilds the database from the recordings alone
a server that is not ready, fails to start or is over budget is a gap, never zero references
